name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 85 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 37% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 85 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 37 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens, while Israeli forces demolished homes in Biddu, displacing over 100 Palestinians and rebuilding a West Bank outpost on a Palestinian family's land. Palestinians in Gaza are improvising infrastructure, building wind turbines from rubble and turning discarded cooking pots into seawalls, as gunfire damaged tents at the Rafah displacement site. Tony Blair met Netanyahu and Herzog to advance a Gaza plan, and Ra’am chief Abbas declined to label Hamas a terror group, citing family safety concerns. The Joint List announced it will back Eisenkot to form Israel's next government. 21,440 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske bosettere tok åtte palestinske hjem i Jeriko, og fordrevet dusinvis, mens israelske styrker rev ned hjem i Biddu, og fordrevet over 100 palestinere og bygde en bosetning på Vestbredden på en palestinsk families jord. Palestinere i Gaza improviserer infrastruktur, bygger vindturbiner av ruiner og gjør om kastede gryter til sjømurer, mens skudd fra skytevåpen ødela telt på Rafah-flyktningleiren. Tony Blair møtte Netanyahu og Herzog for å fremme en Gaza-plan, og Ra’am-leder Abbas avslo å stemple Hamas som en terrororganisasjon, med henvisning til familiesikkerhet. Joint List kunngjorde at de vil støtte Eisenkot for å danne Israels neste regjering. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
